name: Richup.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Richup.io is a free IOGame. Shake, rattle, and roll the dice in this ultimate strategy game of buying, selling, acquiring, rolling, moving, and having a good time. This is a highly strategic real estate game where players will learn to have fun while wheeling, dealing, buying, and selling in the high-stakes world of real-estate. Play against other players from around the world and make them pay rent in this epic game of life and death. Take over the various different railways and resources which players may need in order to move on with their life. You can do it, we believe in you. When you pass go in this game you will receive two hundred dollars. We urge you to re-invest that money into some real estate, charge rent, use that money to buy more real estate, and bankrupt all your friends. Just like in real life. Only the strong will survive in this game of luck, money, and fun. Do you think you have what it takes? You'd better hope so! Because there is no sympathy.
